a.lede: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.
a.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access

b.lede: Anthropic’s paper establishes conceptual model capabilities, but doesn’t quite demonstrate a real threat until models improve further.
b.title: Anthropic warns of self-replicating AI worm threat that doesn't need data centers to self-improve and spread
